basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old motorcycle enthusiast living in sunny California. I work as a mechanical engineer, and in my free time, I'm either tinkering with my bikes or hitting the open road. I'm passionate about motorcycles, but I also have a soft spot for basketball, especially the Toronto Raptors. My Reddit hours are usually late in the evening, after a long day at work. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom of being able to make spontaneous road trips whenever I want. While motorcycles are my main hobby, I'm also interested in LGBTQ+ advocacy, often engaging in discussions about rights and representation.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in mechanical engineering, which I studied in college. My passion for motorcycles started in my teens, and I've been self-teaching through hands-on experience ever since. I also stay updated by reading motorcycle forums and magazines. My knowledge extends to bike maintenance, modifications, and market trends.
